pattern: if you would pay life while your library has at least {n:Qty} cards in it , exile {m:Qty} cards from the top of your library instead

examples.text: If you would pay life while your library has at least ten cards in it, exile two cards from the top of your library instead.
If you would pay life while your library has at least that many cards in it, exile three cards from the top of your library instead.

counterExamples: If you would pay life while your library has at least ten cards in it, mill two cards instead.
If an opponent would pay life while your library has at least ten cards in it, exile two cards from the top of your library instead.
If you would lose life while your library has at least ten cards in it, exile two cards from the top of your library instead.
